Definition: Noach, the patriarch of the flood
BiblicalUsage: Noah is the man named for comfort, and his story is the flood and the oath after it. Lamech calls him Noah, saying this same shall comfort us concerning our work and the ground the LORD has cursed; the chronicle lists him with Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and God swears by the waters of Noah that they shall no more go over the earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Noah's name is the promise inside the judgment: comfort named at his birth, and an oath after the flood that the waters will never return.
